_comment: Pages that must never be tracked in this repo (ADO #1971, #1974).
This repo is public only so GitHub Pages can serve clearthemud.org, so
anything tracked here is published. Untracked pages under races/ exist
precisely because someone decided NOT to publish them, and 'git add
races/' cannot tell the difference: it stages them along with everything
else. That happened twice on 2026-07-28, once reaching the live site.
tools/tests/test_do_not_publish.py fails if any path here is tracked.
Install the hook for a pre-commit check: git config core.hooksPath .githooks
